data.name: Eden's Inferno
data.detailed_description:
A Metroidvania which incorporates 3D Platforming and Retro Shooter elements.

Trouble in Paradise

Ralphaela is a Guardian Angel tasked with watching over humans. One particular human was able to break through her hard exterior and awaken something she forgot a long, long time ago.

To Ralphy's dismay, her human gets sent to Hell, which causes her to lash out against her fellow Angels. She is quickly imprisoned. One day, she receives a mysterious visitor which seems to sympathize with her plight. 

A Large Interconnected World to Explore!

Descend throughout Heaven, Purgatory, and Hell, in search of your human. Each realm has their own challenges, collectibles, enemies to fight, and friends to meet. Features a lot of challenging bosses to fight, and many platforming challenges to complete. Plenty of secrets to discover through exploration. Features a Hubworld which shelters your friends and shopkeepers which you find throughout the world.

Fight Demons, Angels, and Everything In-between!

Retro shooter gameplay which encourages the player to use movement mechanics while fighting. Lots of intimidating bosses and enemies. Features a precise parry system which is tied to swapping weapons. Parrying with specific weapons will "charge" them, giving them a special attack.

Lots of Loot to Collect!

Collecting weapons also gives you additional movement abilities, which allows you to explore more parts of the world. Many of the secrets to find scattered throughout the world reward you with upgrades to your weapons, stat increases, special abilities, or different outfits for Ralphaela.

Retro Inspired Aesthetic!

A low-poly, stylized visual aesthetic which is inspired by games of the early 2000's and late 90's, along with some modern flares.
